review_notes: Independently read the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, both disposition ledgers, coverage.json, and unresolved.json. The reviewed proposal contains four owned fact writes and no links, entities, merges, or follow-ups; it is not the older three-write proposal embedded in context.

All four proposed writes are supported. The forward-throw replacement correctly distinguishes unfinished animation from completed unflagged animation. The stop-walking predicate and physics overspeed comparison have the documented strict boundaries and qualified IEEE NaN behavior.

The entry helper obtains Fighter before changing carrier motion and reads victim_gobj afterward. Its callback is synchronous and not retained. The victim initializer resets grab/work before invoking the optionally skipping updater. Lifetime preservation is correctly stated as a prerequisite, not a proved reentrancy guarantee.

Canonical foreign handlers and actual Donkey/common motion-table registrations support the cargo and Shouldered interpretations. Rendered aliases were not used as independent proof. CargoKneebend collision reuse is confirmed in addition to walk, turn, and landing.

The supplied ledgers account for all 44 facts and all 16 exact outgoing baseline links. Duplicate links remain individually accounted for without consolidation. Five baseline facts are specifically deferred below; one is superseded by the current proposal.

Acceptance does not establish compiled section layout, parameter register assignment, original alias spelling, visual lifting assets, exceptional float-to-int machine results, or complete callback teardown contracts. No replacement proposal or mutation was performed.
